transitions.label: Session start: breakfast outside the storm
transitions.evidence: Session YAML drStart, the morning breakfast in u0003-u0014, and u1189 naming the next morning April 17 establish April 16; u0624 says about 10 a.m.

transitions.label: Departure south
transitions.evidence: u0756 confirms they have not departed; u0763 starts the journey after the morning camp conversation.
transitions.sourceText: Okay, so you set off heading south across the plains.

transitions.label: Afternoon travel and gnoll encounter
transitions.evidence: u0770: after lunchtime, pressing into the afternoon; the dust cloud and gnolls are seen immediately afterward.
transitions.sourceText: And so by after lunchtime. You've only made it, you know, a handful of miles. And as you press on into the afternoon.

transitions.label: Mid-afternoon camp decision
transitions.evidence: u1121 calls the time mid-afternoon; u1125 moves camp away from the bodies.
transitions.sourceText: Like mid afternoon. Now, you could just set up camp here.

transitions.label: Camp and sleep through the night
transitions.evidence: u1177-u1179 move from setting up camp to sleeping for the night; the next morning is explicitly April 17 at u1189.
transitions.sourceText: Okay. Um, so as you set up camp here.

transitions.label: April 17 morning; travel resumes
transitions.evidence: u1189 explicitly states the morning of April 17; u1201-u1206 introduce roughly six days of travel and further rest.

transitions.label: April 23 roadside camp after travel
transitions.evidence: u1217-u1218 explicitly advance six days to April 23; u1215 and u1247 place the discussion on the night before returning to Karawa. Intermediate travel days are covered by the montage, with no individually narrated events.
transitions.sourceText: April 23 now a month and a day after you all met in Karawa.

transitions.label: Next morning; final walk to Karawa
transitions.evidence: u1775 says the next morning dawns; u1778 gives 10–15 miles remaining, and u1844 explicitly confirms April 24.

transitions.label: Arrival at Karawa; time not specified
transitions.evidence: u1778-u1789 narrate the remaining walk and arrival above the town; u1844 confirms April 24, but an exact arrival time is not given. The temple conversations continue on this day through session end.
transitions.sourceText: You come up on the rise.
